items.text: bill galat hai
refund chahiye
charges check karo

items.context: kya aapko lagta hai bill sahi hai
items.text: nahi mujhe nahi lagta

items.context: kya aap thoda wait kar sakte hain
items.text: thoda wait karo

items.context: kya aap bill ke charges confirm kar chuke hain
items.text: bilkul sahi nahi
mera May mahina ka bill bahut zyada aaya hai
Kya aap apna registered mobile number batayenge please
bill mein international calls ke charges include hain jo maine nahi kiye
Mera address 23 sector 12 Gurgaon hai aur bill waha bheja gaya hai
April ke bill mein roaming charges show ho rahe hain jo maine use nahi kiya
May 5 ko main ne ₹500 recharge kiya tha par bill mein double charge hua hai
Mayank Sharma ne dilli se call charges me wrong billing batayi thi

items.context: Kab aapko bill receive hua tha?
items.text: Maine May bill kal hi receive kiya par charge zyada hai

items.context: Aap kis city se call kar rahe hai?
items.text: Main Noida se bol raha hun aur charges galat lag rahe hai bill mein

items.context: Kaunse number par issue aarha hai?
items.text: Mobile number 9876543210 par ye problem aa rahi hai

items.context: Kis date ke bill mein issue hai?
items.text: Mere 10 April ke postpaid bill me do baar ek hi charge lagaya gaya hai

items.context: Kitna extra charge aapke bill mein appear ho raha hai?
items.text: Bill mein ₹1500 add ho gaye hain main ne koi extra services lehi nahi
Mera Delhi ki address par May mahine ka bill aaya hai jisme call charges zyada dikhaye gaye hain jo maine use nahi kiye
Main Gurgaon se bol raha hun aur mere postpaid bill mein roaming ka extra charge lagaya gaya hai joh sahi nahi hai mujhe refund chahiye
Maine apne postpaid number 9988776655 ka bill check kiya to usme ₹2000 se zyada ka charge dusre state ke calls ke naam par hai jo maine nahi kiya

items.context: Aapko kis mahine ke bill mein problem lag rahi hai?
items.text: Mujhe lagta hai ki mere May ke postpaid bill mein 500 rupaye extra charge ho gaye hain kya aap isko verify kar sakte hain

items.context: Aap apna naam aur shahar bata sakte hain?
items.text: Mera naam Ravi Kumar hai aur main Noida se call kar raha hun mera bill galat aaya hai specific date 12th May ke charges mein problem hai

items.context: Kya aap apne recharge details aur address confirm karenge?
items.text: Maine recharge karaya tha par bill me do charges lad diye gaye hain mujhe refund chahiye mera address Delhi ka sector 5 dwarka hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
